findings.finding: FY26 revenue GBP51.1m and adjusted PBT >= GBP11.5m (vs GBP11.4m consensus) were pre-released on 22 July; the results will restate them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY25 finals after a pre-release moved +0.56% (2025-10-13); FY24 finals -1.9% (2024-10-21); the July 2026 pre-release itself +1.3%
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the number has been public for three months and the stock is up from 386.5p on the day to 427p; included only because it is a sourced fact on the print, sized at zero.
findings.independence: H1 report says FY firmly on track: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/tristel--tstl/half-year-financial-report/9452092

findings.finding: Implied H2 FY26 revenue was GBP25.45m (51.1 - 25.65), only +6.4% on H2 FY25's GBP23.93m (46.5 - 22.57) and sequentially below H1, against +14% in H1, so the double-digit growth target needs re-acceleration in FY27 current trading.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no prior Tristel print with a growth-target miss in the record; the stock moved under 2% on every finals day in the baseline
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is derivable from two public RNS and the full-year revenue matched consensus, so the H2 slowdown itself is priced; what is not priced is whether Q1 FY27 trading shows re-acceleration. If the market were worried the stock would not have run +8% over 20 days into the print.
findings.independence: FY26 revenue figure from https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/tristel--tstl/positive-trading-update/9680616 (same company, different document); no external series

findings.finding: Results are the new CEO Chris Lee's first, and he has said he will share 'my vision for the Company's future', making a strategy/investment reset a scheduled possibility in this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no prior CEO-transition results in the baseline record; the June 2026 CEO appointment RNS sat in a period the baseline does not record as a move
findings.original_quote: I look forward to discussing our performance, as well as sharing my vision for the Company's future.
findings.why_not_priced: Content is unknown to everyone; the sign is an inference (new CEOs often step up investment, which on a margin-target name reads negative), so it is sized small with a wide band. Same notice repeats the double-digit growth / >=25% EBITDA targets, which argues against a target cut.
findings.independence: Chair's statement that Lee's US experience suits 'further growth and overseas expansion' points to US investment: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/tristel--tstl/appointment-of-ceo-/9621835
